heard: One battered spacecraft has been mapping Mars for 23 years. Most people think Mars missions die young. Arthur C. Clarke personally approved the name for this historic mission. To reach orbit without wasting fuel, it surfed the Martian atmosphere. A solar storm fried its radiation sensor. Yet the resilient spacecraft survived the blow. It relayed 85% of data from surface rovers like Spirit. That is why one battered spacecraft has been mapping Mars for 23 years.
